title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
desc:
給你一個鏈結串列，刪除串列的倒數第 n 個節點，並且返回串列的頭節點。

進階：你能嘗試使用一趟掃描實現嗎？

solutions.python:
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode:
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next

# 一趟掃描：快慢指標（推薦）
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: Optional[ListNode], n: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)      # 虛擬頭節點，避免特判刪除頭節點
        slow = fast = dummy

        # fast 先走 n + 1 步
        for _ in range(n + 1):
            fast = fast.next

        # 一起走到底，slow 停在待刪節點的前一個
        while fast:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next

        slow.next = slow.next.next     # 刪除
        return dummy.next


# 兩趟掃描：先算長度（較直覺）
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head: Optional[ListNode], n: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        dummy = ListNode(0, head)
        length = 0
        node = head
        while node:
            length += 1
            node = node.next

        # 倒數第 n 個 = 正數第 (length - n + 1) 個
        prev = dummy
        for _ in range(length - n):
            prev = prev.next
        prev.next = prev.next.next
        return dummy.next
